comments.text: Italian native speaker here. A couple of years ago I was looking for TV shows to watch in order to practice my English, and I stumbled upon this gem of a series. I've loved it to bits ever since. When my country was struck by the Coronavirus pandemic there were days in which this masterpiece was the only thing between me and depression. I can't describe how important its "happiness in the little things" message was for me at that time. When all this pandemic business is over I'm writing to mr. Mackenzie Crook to thank him from the bottom of my heart.

comments.author: @Vercingetorix58v.
comments.text: Hello, my name is Martin Schmitz from Germany, and I have never seen such a beautiful, fantastic series as "Detectorists" in my life, these films are so humorous and full of love that one would like to watch all episodes together, it is  already like an addiction, but a nice pleasant addiction!  I've seen a lot of films in my 54 years, but I've never been more delighted by films like the series "Detectorists", the actors and the script are unique, just close to the life of the simple, that's what makes this series so likeable.  "Detectorists" deserves a sequel with new episodes, many people would certainly be grateful for it and these many people are waiting with great longing for a continuation of this unique wonderful series that touches the hearts of so many people!  Please consider a sequel, you would make an audience of millions very happy.  Kind regards, Martin Schmitz

comments.author: @lawz_xyz
comments.text: Detectorists has something special. It's essentially New Sincerity for television, an antidote to the current fashion for dark, graphic detective dramas and cynical postmodern comedy shows. The only problem is it's hard to describe to anyone who hasn't seen it. To say "it's all about a metal detecting club" is a complete red herring, as it goes so much deeper. I usually say "just watch it" and leave it at that.

comments.author: @yt299
comments.text: This show transports you to the beautiful  English Countryside in summer.  It pulls you in to the lives of quirky, interesting, funny and relateable characters as they navigate love, friendships and a truly unique hobby where an average person can become an archaeologist.   Watching rhis show,  you can share the the thrill of searching for,  but not necessarily  finding, the treasures of our history.  It teaches the lesson that the goodness, the value, may be in the search, the walk through the field, paying attention to the birds, sitting in the shade of a big beautiful tree, sharing a conversation and tea with a friend.  I was so impressed with the writing, acting, pacing and music of the show.  One of my favorite shows ever.  Rekindled my interest in metal detecting.  A true gem of a TV show.
